title: Lists
description: Compare multiple lists and return the intersection, difference, or union.

parameters.name: input
parameters.description: List of input columns containing lists to compare.

parameters.name: ignore_case
parameters.description: Ignore case when comparing string items.

parameters.name: if
parameters.description: Condition that determines whether the wrangle runs as a whole. Recipe variables may be referenced with `${variable}`.

parameters.name: where
parameters.description: Filter rows before applying the wrangle using SQL-like criteria, such as `column1 = 123 OR column2 = 'abc'`.

parameters.name: where_params
parameters.description: Values used with `where` for parameterized criteria. Uses SQLite placeholder syntax such as `?` or `:name`.

guidance:
Compare multiple lists and return the intersection, difference, or union. ## Migrated examples #### Comparing the difference between two columns of lists ##### Recipe ```yaml wrangles: - compare.lists: input: - col1 - col2 output: Difference method: difference ```
##### Input Sample | Col1 | Col2 | | --- | --- | | [A, B, C] | [C, D, E] | | [H, I, J, K] | [H, I, J] | | [X, Y, Z] | [1, 2, 3] |
##### Output Sample | Difference | | --- | | [A, B] | | [K] | | [X, Y, Z] |
#### Comparing the intersection between two columns of lists ##### Recipe ```yaml wrangles: - compare.lists: input: - col1 - col2 output: Intersection method: intersection ```
##### Input Sample | Col1 | Col2 | | --- | --- | | [A, B, C] | [C, D, E] | | [H, I, J, K] | [H, I, J] | | [X, Y, Z] | [1, 2, 3] |
##### Output Sample | Intersection | | --- | | [C] | | [H, I, J] | | [] |
#### Comparing the union between two columns of lists ##### Recipe ```yaml wrangles: - compare.lists: input: - col1 - col2 output: Union method: union ```
##### Input Sample | Col1 | Col2 | | --- | --- | | [A, B, C] | [C, D, E] | | [H, I, J, K] | [H, I, J] | | [X, Y, Z] | [1, 2, 3] |
##### Output Sample | Union | | --- | | [A, B, C, D, E] | | [H, I, J, K] | | [X, Y, Z, 1, 2, 3] |
